answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the signal audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the beacon band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 182 to 337 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the wander identity is graded at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
